thresholds.status: range_elasticity/travel bands are MEASURED on 3969 name-sessions; alive_rvol and liquidity_floor are UNVALIDATED defaults -- move them from the journal, never from opinion

schedule.note: the job loops and rebuilds on its own interval; cron only starts a loop

measures.rvol_cum: volume since the open vs what this name normally trades by this time of day
measures.rvol_now: the last 30 minutes vs the same 30 minutes on its own normal days -- is it STILL going
measures.rvol_open: the old 09:20-09:45 opening-range measure, kept for comparison only
measures.rvol_peak: the busiest half hour of the day so far, and peak_at says when
measures.profile: the whole session in half-hour buckets, each vs its own norm -- the day's shape
measures.range_mult: how far it has travelled vs how far it normally travels by now
measures.char: ABSORBING = it traded a lot and went nowhere · DISPLACING = the volume is genuinely moving price
measures.travel: how far it moved vs how far this much volume normally moves it (1.0 = normal)
measures.adv_cr: its own normal full-day turnover in Rs crore -- can you get size in and out
measures.pos_in_range: 0 = sitting on the day's low, 1 = on the day's high
